mentions.name: DNTLS
mentions.description: This project builds direct peer-to-peer connectivity using secure mTLS tunnels over IPv6, allowing users to load websites hosted locally on each other's machines. It also supports coordinating traffic through a relay to avoid publishing public IPs, aiming to recreate the "old" internet with everything mTLS-protected and end-to-end encrypted.
mentions.source_excerpt: Spending almost all of my time working on DNTLS (https://dntls.net/). Yesterday I was able to create secure mTLS tunnels over IPv6 for direct P2P to my co-founder's desktop in SE Asia (I'm in the US). He was able to load a website I was hosting locally on my machine. I also tested coordinating through a relay to avoid publishing my public IP and sending all traffic through the relay to hide my IP entirely. We more or less recreated the "old" internet in a way except everything is mTLS and E2E encrypted.
mentions.author: aliasxneo
